_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Kɛlɛm koom koom zɛɛrɛ wɩɩdɛɛrɛ kɛɛm sɔɔlɛ wɛɛrɛ.
Kɛlɛm wɩɩdɛɛrɛ ni `[A 5]`, wɩɩdɛɛrɛ dɔɔn dɔɔn.

invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Bõn-bil ning sẽn yaa {letter} pa be yel-solemd pʋgẽ ye.
invalid_move.digit_used: Digit {digit} zoe n yaa a sẽn tũ ne {used_letter}.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Gomd sẽn sɩng ne sõor pa tõe n yɩ 0.

outcome.correct: Yaa sɩda, d sẽn paam tɩ b makrã zemsame wã yĩnga.
outcome.incorrect: Bã-gãong n sa, la b pa tõe n bãng a sẽn yaa to-to ye.
outcome.limit: B sẽn tõe n kẽn to-to wã taa b tɛka.
